description:
Two coupled findings in the abort path:

1. `loop.ex:345` (aborted_messages/1) and `session.ex:244`
   (on_loop_down abnormal branch) each synthesize an aborted
   Assistant independently. They differ: only Session's version
   sets `error_message`. A cooperative abort (flag flipped between
   turns) goes through the loop's path and produces an inconsistent
   transcript vs. a hard abort.

2. `loop.ex:63` emits `[:octo_pi_agent, :session, :stop]` only on
   the clean-exit path. Hard-aborted runs never fire a :stop event,
   so run duration metering silently drops them.

Fix:
- Extract a single aborted-Assistant helper (e.g.
  `OctoPi.Agent.Event.aborted_assistant/0` or a Session private
  helper used by both paths).
- Make on_loop_down abnormal branch emit session:stop with
  `reason: :aborted` and a duration (start_mono tracked on the
  store / session state, or reconstructed from abort_ref creation
  timestamp).

TDD:
- Test: cooperative abort transcript has error_message set.
- Test: hard abort emits [:octo_pi_agent, :session, :stop] with
  reason :aborted.
title: Unify aborted-assistant + emit session:stop telemetry on abnormal exit
